assertions.description: A quadrotor holds its declared altitude setpoint to within 3% using four declared rotors and a declared altitude-hold law.
Rotor thrust equals Ct*rho_air*A*v_tip^2 recomputed from the MEASURED rpm, to within 2%.
The force the airframe must fight against 2, 5 and 9 m/s winds matches 0.5*rho*Cd*A*v^2 within 2% and rises monotonically.
